 Horseshit!

glosses: Blatant nonsense, more likely stemming from ignorance than any intent to deceive.

examples.text: He thinks vinegar is alkaline? Don't you realize that's horseshit?
He claims that he wasn't at that meeting? Don't you realize that's horseshit?

A huge one. It was my job to mix the horseshit in with the soil. Great big wheelbarrows full of horseshit. We used to drive around to farms that had horses and ask them if we could shovel up their horseshit.
The aroma was a mix of cedar, hay and horseshit but somehow, Betty found it pleasantly intoxicating.
You understand, of course, that everything I say is horseshit.
